verdicts.explanation: The paper states Li3P (s = 1.0 × 10-3 S/cm) in the Figure 2 discussion, and Section 3 says the RT conductivities were compiled from previous literature (Table S1). The RT condition comes from the general text, so measurement_temperature_C null is acceptable, and all secondary fields are null as the paper gives none for Li3P.

The paper states b-Li3N (s = 2.085 × 10-4 S/cm) in the same sentence, from the compiled RT literature dataset (Table S1). The value, unit, RT condition and literature origin match, and all secondary fields are correctly null.
